title: Aksomati
extract:
The Aksomati are twin machine-pistols inspired by the  Soma assault rifle, similarly sporting a large magazine, high critical stats, very fast fire rate, and a spool-up effect.

Characteristics
This weapon primarily deals  Slash damage.
Auto-Spool: Requires a spool-up of 6 shots before optimal fire rate is achieved.
Fire rate starts at 25% of the listed value and increases by 15% per shot.
Accuracy lowers as fire rate ramps up.
Advantages over other Secondary   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Fully Spooled (wiki attack index 1)
High crit chance (24.00%)
High magazine size (70)
Very high ammo pickup (40)
Above average reload speed (1.40 s)
Very high ammo max (420)
Very high fire rate (12.50 attacks/sec)
Above average disposition (●●●●○ (1.25x))
Very high crit multiplier (3.00x)
Disadvantages over other Secondary   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Fully Spooled (wiki attack index 1)
Low damage per shot (26.64)
Very low total damage (18)
Low accuracy (5.00° to 8.00°)
Very low status chance (8.00%)
See WARFRAME Wiki:Stat Comparison/Percentiles for more details.

Comparisons:

 Aksomati (Fully Spooled), compared to  Aksomati Prime (Fully Spooled):
Lower base damage per projectile (18.00 vs. 20.00)
Lower  Impact damage ( 1.8 vs.  2)
Lower  Puncture damage ( 7.2 vs.  8)
Lower  Slash damage ( 9 vs.  10)
Lower total damage (18 vs. 20)
Lower base status chance (8.00% vs. 18.00%)
Lower average damage per tap (26.64 vs. 29.6)
Lower burst DPS (333 vs. 394.56)
Lower sustained DPS (266.4 vs. 319.93)
Lower fire rate (12.50 attacks/sec vs. 13.33 attacks/sec)
Smaller magazine (70 vs. 80)
Smaller max ammo capacity (420 vs. 880)
Faster spool-up (6 rounds vs. 11 rounds)
More accurate (15.4 vs. 12.5)
Wider first-shot spread (5.00° vs. 0.00°)
Tighter maximum spread (8.00° vs. 16.00°)
Less polarities ( vs. )

Acquisition
The Aksomati's blueprint can be purchased from the Market.

This weapon can be sold for  5,000.

Notes
Like the  Soma – their rifle counterpart – the Aksomati have a short spool-up time before reaching their maximum fire rate.

Tips
Similarly to the Soma, using a  Pistol Ammo Mutation or  Primed Pistol Ammo Mutation can help with ammo conservation issues.
This is particularly useful because the Aksomati have a built in  polarity.
Using a maxed  Pistol Gambit allows for a 52.8% critical chance to be obtained.
Using a maxed  Target Cracker allows for a 4.8 times critical multiplier
Using a maxed  Hollow Point in addition to a maxed Target Cracker allows for a 6.6 times critical multiplier, albeit at a loss of damage.
Using a maxed  Gunslinger allows for up to 21.5 rounds to be fired per second.
Using a maxed  Lethal Torrent in addition to a maxed Gunslinger allows for up to 29 rounds to be fired per second, in addition to gaining a 60% multishot bonus.
Using a maxed  Anemic Agility in addition to both a maxed Gunslinger and maxed Lethal Torrent allows for up to 40.3 rounds to be fired a second, albeit at a loss of damage and ammo efficiency.

Trivia
The Aksomati's magazine acts similarly to the Soma's: when firing the weapons, the magazines slowly raise from the bottom to exit out the top, before being ejected once empty.
